My husband and I were involved in a very serious traffic accident with multiple injuries, and I spent the first two weeks in the intensive care unit.During one of the hardest times of my life, I experienced an incredible level of care, kindness, and humanity in this hospital that I will never forget.

The nurses and staff in the ICU were unbelievably kind, caring, and helpful. Whenever I needed anything, someone came within seconds. They washed and cared for me from head to toe every day, and they even braided my hair for me. Despite my condition, I was always treated with dignity and compassion.

The doctors checked on me daily and carefully monitored everything. Because my condition was very critical and my husband was extremely worried, Dr. Dear constantly updated him about my condition and always took the time to explain everything.

When I was transferred to the regular ward, I had the exact same positive experience. The nurses were incredibly attentive, loving, and always there whenever I needed help. Especially during situations that felt uncomfortable or embarrassing to me, such as being washed or having my diaper changed, they never made me feel ashamed. Instead, they always reassured me that it was completely normal and part of their job.

After several weeks in the hospital, I began struggling mentally and went through depressive phases. Whenever the nurses noticed me crying, some of them would sit with me for up to 30 minutes just to comfort me and cheer me up. That kind of compassion means more to me than words can describe.

The wound care team was also amazing. The man who cleaned my wounds every day was incredibly kind and made me feel completely comfortable. The nurses from the wound care department were equally gentle, professional, and caring.

One moment I will never forget was my birthday during my stay in the ICU. I was heartbroken that I had to spend it in a hospital bed, but Dr. Joy, the gynecologist, and the nurses still managed to make it a beautiful day for me. They brought me a cake and even a gift. I will always be grateful for that kindness.

There was also another doctor — unfortunately I cannot remember his name — who showed exceptional kindness. I had asked him why I had a heavy coating on my tongue even though I do not smoke and had barely eaten. He explained everything to me very patiently. I told him it would be enough if he simply told my husband where to buy the proper products. But the next morning, during his rounds, he personally brought me a mouthwash and a tongue scraper. I will never forget such a thoughtful gesture.

The rooms were also excellent: very large, modern, and always clean. A cleaning service came every day. We had our own bathroom, a kitchen, TV, WiFi, and even a couch so my husband could stay and sleep beside me. The view was beautiful as well.

I would never wish a hospital stay on anyone. But if someone ever needs medical care, I truly hope they receive the same level of treatment and compassion that I received here.

Thank you to the entire staff — doctors, nurses, cleaning staff, and everyone involved.You have my deepest respect. Despite all the pain and injuries, you made my stay as comfortable and positive as possible.Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

The doctors and staff are great, but the prices for medications are three times higher than at the nearby pharmacy.
I don't think it should be that way.
There are a lot of staff at the reception desk in the hospital, but it’s not clear why so many are needed. Another downside is that they speak English very poorly, which is surprising for an international hospital.
Even if you have an appointment scheduled for a specific time, there’s no need to rush. Doctors consistently run behind schedule, and waiting at least 30-45 minutes past your appointment time seems to be the norm.
The hospital clearly lacks a dedicated manager who could help improve communication with international patients and ensure that doctors adhere more closely to their scheduled appointment times.

I gave birth to my baby girl here 🥰

The hospital is wonderful, with caring staff, professional doctors, and excellent service.

A special thank you to the entire team who was by our side during one of the most important moments of our lives. Your kindness, attention, and dedication meant so much to our family🙏

We are truly grateful and would highly recommend this hospital!

I came to Wattanapat Hospital for prenatal care during my first and second trimesters, for both of my pregnancies, and each time I received such great care! From the moment I arrived at the hospital for my appointments all the way to the end, everything was always so seamless. You definitely get what you pay for - high quality private care that gives you peace of mind. Though I did not specifically give birth here as I went back to my home country, I highly recommend pregnant women coming here for prenatal care!😊

This review is based purely on the organisation and administration of the hospital, not the medical staff.

I gave birth here and had been a registered patient for quite some time. I attended regular appointments with my doctor, had a birth plan in place, my insurance was approved, and all paperwork had already been completed. Despite all of this, when I arrived in labour and was literally being wheeled through reception to give birth, the staff stopped us and insisted that we make payment immediately.

At that moment I was about to push and deliver my daughter, yet they were demanding payment before the birth had even happened. They could not even know at that stage what type of birth it would be or what the final cost would be. We were also staying in the hospital for two nights afterwards, and of course we had passports, credit cards and everything needed to settle the bill. The timing and lack of judgement in that situation was incredibly stressful and unnecessary.

Unfortunately, this is not an isolated incident. Every single time we visit this hospital there seems to be confusion at the entrance, even though we are already registered patients and all of our information has been on file for years. We are repeatedly asked for passport copies, there is constant confusion about insurance, and it often causes delays that make us late for our appointments.

Even after the appointment, the same pattern continues. When waiting for medication there are often further delays because paperwork has not been sent to the pharmacy or insurance details are questioned again.

The medical staff themselves have been good, but the level of disorganisation among the administrative staff is extremely frustrating. When you or your child are unwell, the last thing you want to deal with is repeated confusion and delays over paperwork that the hospital already has on file.

It really takes away from what could otherwise be a very good hospital experience.

I liked both the doctors and the clinic itself. Everything is new and fresh, and the staff is polite. There’s a spacious cafeteria(Thai food), as well as a K.O.B café with bakery.
Compared to Bangkok Hospital, it’s simpler here, but faster. Prices are lower, but you should double-check all the documents if you need to submit them to your insurance company.

I was solo travelling for my first time and had an injury and was taken to this hospital. I recieved great care and empathy as i was very scared  for my first surgery & was even given a little gift to make me feel better. Everyone was extremely kind and made me feel like i wasn’t alone, and made sure all my needs were met. Staff explained everything to the best of their ability, couldnt recommend this hospital more 🩷

I’m terms of insurance, everything went smoothly and the hospital and my insurance company dealt with everything together which relieved a lot of stress

If I could I would give minus 5 stars.
Very disappointing experience. From the moment we arrived, it was clear that billing mattered more than patient care. …

I am pleased to leave this super positive review for this hospital. My hernia was treated surgically by Dr. Joy with excellent pre- and post-operative results. I received the utmost attention and professionalism from all the staff. The hospital is a 5-star, clean, and elegant facility.

I received treatment at this hospital under my social security insurance for a breast lump.

Over the past month, I've had to take time off work twice for hospital appointments without receiving any tests.

I had appointments with specialists, but they were constantly postponed. Most recently, today, I went for my appointment, but I was still being passed back and forth between the social security ward and the surgical ward.
I'm very disappointed with the system that doesn't prioritize patients and social security insurance.

My case was initially sent to this ward, but the counter staff told me to go back to the original ward. They kept passing me around. In the end, I had to go back to the surgical ward for treatment. I traveled from Koh Phangan, spending both money and time taking time off work. I didn't even get to eat breakfast while waiting. (Anyway, money is more important.)

However, I would like to commend the nurse in the social security ward for her politeness, enthusiasm, and for being the only one who truly cared for the patient.

I hope the hospital will take this matter into consideration and improve its service system, uphold medical ethics, and prioritize social security beneficiaries more than they currently do. (Bad service I've never experienced in my life.)

A Top-Notch and Affordable Healthcare Experience with Great Food at Wattanapat Hospital on Samui

Three months ago, Wattanapat Hospital on Samui opened its doors to the public, providing an incredible healthcare experience that surpasses even its high-priced competitors. I recently had the pleasure of being a patient here, and I am compelled to share my outstanding experience with others.

The hospital's modern, state-of-the-art facilities and commitment to maintaining a high standard of cleanliness left a lasting impression on me. The staff at Wattanapat Hospital is truly exceptional - caring, professional, and always willing to go above and beyond to ensure patients are comfortable and well taken care of.

An additional aspect of Wattanapat Hospital that I particularly enjoyed was the fantastic selection of Western food available. As someone who appreciates good food, I was thrilled to find American-style pancakes and delicious cheese and egg sandwiches on the menu. The quality and taste of these dishes were excellent, providing a sense of comfort and familiarity during my stay.

What sets Wattanapat Hospital apart from other facilities, such as the overpriced Bangkok Hospital on Samui, is its affordability without compromising on quality. The hospital offers a range of room options, including standard and VIP rooms. I stayed in a standard room and was thoroughly impressed by its spaciousness (over 30 sqm), spotless en-suite bathroom, smart TV, and super-fast Wi-Fi.

Not only does Wattanapat Hospital offer a superior healthcare experience, but it also does so at a much more reasonable price point compared to other establishments in the area. This makes it an excellent choice for both locals and visitors in need of medical attention.

In conclusion, Wattanapat Hospital on Samui has quickly become a game-changer in the healthcare industry on the island. With its top-notch facilities, caring staff, competitive pricing, and delicious food options, I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone in need of medical care. Five stars well deserved!

I was on vacation with my family and unfortunately developed a high fever and diarrhea during the night. So I went to the hospital. I was seen immediately and filled out a questionnaire – the staff seemed a bit annoyed, perhaps because I was a tourist.

After a short time, I was taken to the emergency room in a wheelchair. There, I received a check-up and was immediately put on an IV drip due to dehydration. Everything was very clean, and the staff were very friendly and even used translators if I didn't know the medical terminology in English. I was advised to stay overnight because, according to a blood test (the results were available just one hour after the sample was taken!), I had bacteria in my gastrointestinal tract. 🩺 After that, I was admitted to a ward. I was checked on every one to two hours, which made a very positive impression. The food was absolutely good compared to what I'd get in Germany. My medication was always brought to me, and I was given an explanation of its purpose.


The staff always provided the medication and explained what it was for.





































. ... ❤️ A very special thank you goes to Dr. Sasipa (Tan) 🥰 and Kitiwan (Nam), 🥰 nurse – thanks to these two lovely ladies, I felt completely at ease and can only offer the highest praise. This is exactly the kind of treatment you want, no matter where you are, especially when you're in a foreign country with a different language.

Absolutely fantastic!!! 👍🏼
This allowed me to catch my flight home the next day.

I can definitely recommend this hospital from a medical perspective.

At the end, I received a bag of medication to take with me, with individual instructions on what each medication was for and how to take it. 💊

Thanks to my international health insurance, everything regarding costs was sorted out on-site, and the process was smooth. 📑

We are incredibly grateful that my dad was admitted here by a doctor. Her suspected diagnosis was confirmed very quickly, and the entire team immediately took care of everything. The hospital management handled the insurance claim.

After my dad developed severe pneumonia, he had to spend four days in the intensive care unit. The entire team was always cheerful and cared for my dad with great dedication. Dr. Tanyawan Pratoomsuwan always had a smile on her face from the very beginning and was always ready to answer our questions. The team remained calm and collected even in difficult situations. The medical and nursing care was outstanding. Everyone was willing to use the mobile translator, and communication was easy. We thank the entire team from the bottom of our hearts ❤️
expensive and useless

We had an accident, and from the very first moment, the care at this hospital was exceptional. They looked after us constantly, and all the staff were incredibly kind and attentive.

We especially want to highlight Nurse Uraiwan, who was incredibly attentive to us at all times. We had to go every day for wound care, and they always treated us with immense patience, kindness, and a very positive attitude.

Furthermore, the hospital is brand new, with spectacular facilities and everything perfectly organized.

We are very grateful for all the help we received. We wholeheartedly recommend this hospital.

First Impression: I was very impressed. This was my first time here, and the service and care were excellent. From the reception staff, everyone was polite and very professional. The nurses were very attentive and caring.
The doctor was also lovely and very caring, giving excellent advice. I was extremely impressed. This is the best hospital I've ever used. 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
Beautiful new hospital.

Negligent!
I do not recommend to say the least, I arrived bleeding at 15 weeks pregnant, they did not do blood tests, they sent me home every week, they told me that the wait for cervical surgery has been two weeks, which in the end led to incorrect indicators that they saw in Israel, the ultrasounds are unprofessional and the doctors are the same. I returned to Israel in an emergency situation without water in the amniotic fluid, and they hospitalized me right when I arrived in Israel, which they did not do there. Anyone who wants a safe pregnancy. It is certainly not there! (Not for pregnant women at risk)

We were in the emergency room at night with our baby. Unfortunately, there was no pediatrician on duty, but the doctor still examined our baby thoroughly and prescribed the necessary medication. The next day, we were able to see a pediatrician, who made the diagnosis and prescribed appropriate medication as well.

It's worth noting that nothing extra was done without informing or asking us beforehand. The costs are a bit higher for Thailand, but still reasonable. Anyone with insurance is well covered anyway.

All the staff and doctors were very friendly and made a great impression. The hospital is also very new and modernly equipped.

Our only suggestion for improvement: more transparent pricing. It would be helpful to list standard services so patients can better estimate the costs in advance.

Otherwise, everything was excellent – ​​thank you so much for the quick and effective treatment!

I was an inpatient at Wattanapat Hospital for 11 days following an accident and subsequent surgery.

I've never seen such a high standard in a hospital before.

The staff was very friendly, competent, and helpful. Cleanliness is also a top priority here.

All in all, it's a very good hospital that definitely has a higher standard than our European hospitals!
Thank you to Watthanapat Samui Hospital for providing a visitation service on behalf of the agent. The staff were very friendly and helpful; both the client and the agent were very impressed.

text: I came for a health checkup at the health promotion center. From the start, the service was excellent. The service points, the counters, and the nurses in the center were all attentive and friendly, unlike other hospitals I've used before.

I cannot rate this hospital highly enough. I contracted pneumonia and collapsed lung and threated me. This hospital is outstanding. I also need to mention Dr Tanyawan Pratoomsuwan. She is without doubt an excellent Doctor and I would not be here today if it were not for her. Thank you Dr Tanyawan. X

I highly recommend this hospital. I cut my hand while snorkeling, and the hotel recommended this hospital to me. After filling out a questionnaire, I was immediately taken to another department for further treatment. Everyone was very kind and accommodating, and everything went very quickly. I also received a tetanus shot and pain medication as a precaution. I was informed about the costs beforehand. I went back for a follow-up examination, and it was just as quick and everyone was very friendly, just like the first visit.

Thank you for everything.

The doctors radiate an incredibly positive aura. They take their time, attend to their patients attentively, and work with the utmost professionalism and competence. Decisions are made as a team – hand in hand. Close communication among them minimizes risk. The doctors' transparent and calm demeanor, in particular, helped us maintain composure during a difficult time.

A key figure in this hospital is Dr. Dear. She coordinated everything for us throughout our entire stay. Her warm and caring nature gave us strength and perseverance and was a great source of moral support during this challenging period. Every day, she provided us with detailed information – something rarely seen in Germany.

A huge thank you also goes to the ICU. The nurses truly embody the hospital's motto: "We truly care." They are extremely caring, cautious, courteous, and exceptionally well-trained.

We would also like to thank the nurses on Ward 2. A truly wonderful team – everything was perfectly coordinated and always accompanied by a smile.


Dr. Dear I wouldn't wish a hospital stay on anyone. But if someone does, then definitely in this hospital.
The atmosphere was great, and the service was excellent. I was very impressed.

I would like to sincerely thank all the hospital staff for the warm welcome and excellent care you provided. Everyone was incredibly kind, always smiling and attentive. This makes the whole experience much more reassuring and pleasant, and …
The hospital is beautiful and clean, but overall it doesn't quite deserve 5 stars.
Excellent Service! Doctors and nurses were very kind and accommodating!

I would like to inform the hospital management about a problem that needs addressing. Specifically at the social security clinic, the staff and personnel are very rude and seem unwilling to provide service. There has been no improvement despite my repeated visits.

Hospital canteen has the best green curry ive had in my life. Despite the unfortunate situation of being stuck in the hospital for a week, the green curry made it worth it🔥🔥💯💯(not really)
Hospital staff were nice though, comfortable conditions and felt i was being taken care of.
Excellent service. The staff are very polite. The place is clean and organized. They have a full team of specialists, so seeing a doctor doesn't take long.
Good service but very expensive, motorcycle accident, 30 minutes spent treating leg wound, tetanus vaccine and an x-ray, 17000 THB.

text: We came in January this year. My 1 year old daughter had a chesty cough, which required antibiotics. The doctor Napatham Sunsuwan suggested my daughter needs a chest xray. He had no idea I was a doctor myself. He tried to scare me saying she could get pneumonia(!) When he released I was medical he backtracked. Completely unethical practice. They do not follow radiation guidelines and have no ethics if they are willing to expose a one year old girl to radiation unnecessarily understanding increased cancer risk in her life time. He sheepishly went on to prescribe antibiotics which were the wrong antibiotics (given for skin infections) and I sent it back and told them what to prescribe and the dose. Unethical, incompetent, negligent care - to top it off, all they care is about making money other ethics. You’d be at their helm if you had a real medical emergency and were relying on this bunch. Avoid if you can.

Following an accident, I received very prompt care at the hospital. The staff were efficient, professional, and reassuring at every stage. The diagnosis was made quickly, the operation went well, and the post-operative care was excellent.
Everything went very well from a medical standpoint. Yes, as is often the case abroad, medical care comes at a cost: nothing is free.

I remain very satisfied with the quality of care I received.

This is a newly opened, luxurious private hospital with a beautiful exterior. However, after using their services a few times, it didn't live up to expectations. The staff lacked expertise; they couldn't answer registration questions. The …
The service here is incredible. My husband received a small cake for his birthday...best decision ever to stay here on Koh Samui and have the treatments here.

My boyfriend stepped on a sea urchin. Our hotel provided first aid and then immediately drove us to Wattanapt Hospital. My boyfriend was treated right away; four to six nurses, orderlies, and doctors came immediately to remove the spines and give him a tetanus shot. We got antibiotics and painkillers from the hospital's pharmacy. Everything was explained very clearly. We paid about €175, and we received a detailed invoice and a doctor's report for our private insurance. Everything there is very sterile and hygienic. The English skills could be better, but they helped out with a translation program. The staff are very friendly and helpful, and we can recommend the hospital without hesitation.

Don’t go here if you are in dire need of help. My friend got into a bad accident and they refused to do anything until payment has shown up in their accounts, DESPITE being shown the receipt for transfer of funds. When sending a large sum …

Don't be fooled into coming in. They refused to let me in for the inspection and insisted on a different type of test, even though I had spoken to an officer on the phone earlier who said, "Yes, you can come in!" It's a waste of time.

I received treatment at this hospital under my social security insurance for a breast lump.

Over the past month, I've had to take time off work twice for hospital appointments without receiving any tests.

I had appointments with specialists, but they were constantly postponed. Most recently, today, I went for my appointment, but I was still being passed back and forth between the social security ward and the surgical ward.
I'm very disappointed with the system that doesn't prioritize patients and social security insurance.

My case was initially sent to this ward, but the counter staff told me to go back to the original ward. They kept passing me around. In the end, I had to go back to the surgical ward for treatment. I traveled from Koh Phangan, spending both money and time taking time off work. I didn't even get to eat breakfast while waiting. (Anyway, money is more important.)

However, I would like to commend the nurse in the social security ward for her politeness, enthusiasm, and for being the only one who truly cared for the patient.

I hope the hospital will take this matter into consideration and improve its service system, uphold medical ethics, and prioritize social security beneficiaries more than they currently do. (Bad service I've never experienced in my life.)
